candidateBinding: Per-file SHA-256 binds the working candidate. Fresh PR CI supplies execution evidence for the added regressions; baseline passes do not verify a changed source file.
validationSemantics: Domain UTC instants use the canonical domain predicate. Wire schemas retain contracts calendar constraints. External RFC3339 normalization, typed arithmetic, optional undated values and unguarded stored-record admissions are distinct contexts, not interchangeable acceptance evidence.
testBindingSemantics: References inherit their record baselineModuleSuites and additionalRegressionSuites plus the shared suites below. A module pass is not an assertion that every arithmetic context has its own field-level UTC regression.
